channel.title: DevShelf Weekly - Free Developer Tools, APIs & Open Source
channel.description: Weekly curated developer newsletter featuring verified open-source alternatives, free cloud infrastructure, public APIs, and developer perks with zero paywalls.

item.title: Issue #3: Local-First AI Agents, Fast Postgres Branching, and Weather Radar APIs
item.description:
This week: Run local LLM agents without cloud API tokens, instant Postgres branches with Neon, and accurate free weather forecasts without credit cards.

⚡ Issue Sponsor: Neon - Serverless Postgres with Instant Git-like Branching (Permanent generous free tier with zero cold starts.)

🛠️ Featured Zero-Paywall Tools

  • RowSafe: AI-assisted PostgreSQL CLI guard that prevents accidental destructive DROP, TRUNCATE, and unindexed bulk updates.
  • CurlShot: Zero-config terminal tool to convert curl commands into beautiful, shareable developer documentation snippets.
  • Open-Meteo: Public weather forecast and climate API with up to 10,000 daily requests free with no API key required.
  • Open-WebUI: Self-hosted, ChatGPT-like web UI for local models (Ollama, vLLM) with multi-model chat, RAG, and voice.
  • Bruno: Fast, git-friendly open-source desktop API client alternative to Postman and Insomnia with local collection storage.

🎁 Perk of the Week: DigitalOcean $200 Free Cloud Credits - Get $200 in free cloud infrastructure credits for 60 days to deploy Droplets, Kubernetes, and App Platform apps.

item.title: Issue #2: Zero-Paywall Database Stacks, API Prototyping, and Terminal Multiplexers
item.description:
This week: Complete $0/month production database stacks, mock data generators for frontend testing, and modern terminal environments.

⚡ Issue Sponsor: Supabase - The Open Source Firebase Alternative (Free Postgres database, Auth, APIs, and Realtime with 500MB storage.)

🛠️ Featured Zero-Paywall Tools

  • Supabase: The open-source Firebase alternative with Postgres database, Authentication, instant APIs, and Realtime subscriptions.
  • Mockoon: The easiest and quickest way to run local mock REST APIs offline with route rules and JSON templating.
  • Zellij: A modern terminal workspace and multiplexer written in Rust with built-in layouts, tabs, and floating panes.
  • Ollama: Get up and running with Llama 3, Mistral, and other large language models locally with a single command.
  • ReqRes: A hosted REST-API ready to respond to your AJAX requests with realistic simulated developer responses.

🎁 Perk of the Week: Hetzner Cloud €20 Free Server Credits - Test dedicated cloud compute instances across Europe and North America with €20 in free initial credits.

item.title: Issue #1: DevShelf Launch Edition — 500+ Zero-Paywall Tools for Developers
item.description:
In our inaugural edition: Why we built DevShelf, the 100% zero-paywall pledge, and 5 foundational developer tools everyone should bookmark.

🛠️ Featured Zero-Paywall Tools

  • PocketBase: 1-file backend in Go consisting of embedded SQLite database with real-time subscriptions, auth, and file storage.
  • Ripgrep: Line-oriented search tool that recursively searches the current directory for a regex pattern faster than GNU grep.
  • REST Countries: Get information about countries via a RESTful API with currency, flags, calling codes, and coordinates.
  • Vitest: Blazing fast unit test framework powered by Vite with modern ESM, TypeScript, and Jest-compatible API.
  • Starship: The minimal, blazing-fast, and infinitely customizable prompt for any shell with git status and runtime versions.

🎁 Perk of the Week: Vultr $100 Free Cloud Credits - Deploy global compute, bare metal, and managed Kubernetes with $100 in trial credits.
